quarterly_data.signal: Q2 revenue grew 27% to $23.3 million on record volume of 115,000 analyses, up 22%. U.S. revenue grew 64% and volume 60%; liquid-biopsy revenue grew 80%. The platform has earned adoption across more than 1,000 institutions in 75 countries.
quarterly_data.figure: revenue $23.3M (+27%); 115,000 analyses (+22%); U.S. revenue +64%; liquid biopsy +80%

quarterly_data.signal: The company added 24 customers, reached 542 core genomics customers and 80 liquid-biopsy customers, more than half of which had not yet begun generating revenue. Net dollar retention rose to 117% and annualized revenue churn remained below 1%.
quarterly_data.figure: 24 new customers; 542 core customers; 80 liquid-biopsy customers; NDR 117%; churn <1%

quarterly_data.signal: Full-year revenue guidance increased to $94 million-$96 million, representing 22%-24% growth. Cash was $107.7 million after a $57.5 million gross follow-on offering; management targets approaching adjusted EBITDA breakeven by year-end 2026 and positive adjusted EBITDA in H2 2027.
quarterly_data.figure: FY revenue $94M-$96M (+22%-24%); cash $107.7M; positive adjusted EBITDA H2 2027 target

connects_to.relationship: AI models, real-world evidence, test deployments, and companion diagnostics

contracts.signal: AstraZeneca expanded its multi-year relationship into SOPHiA's first two companion-diagnostic programs: a decentralized solid-tumor CDx and a hematological-oncology CDx. Prior work included patient-selection and trial-design AI models, real-world evidence access and sponsored global test deployments; the new programs are expected to contribute mainly from 2027.
